<function name="TangentT" parent="mesh" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Sets the `T` tangent to be used.

Tangents and binormals are using in bumpmap rendering.

See also <page>mesh.TangentS</page> and <page>mesh.Begin</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="tangentT" type="Vector">The T tangent.</arg>
	</args>
	<args name="Direct numbers input">
		<arg name="x" type="number">The X part of the vertex' tangent T.</arg>
		<arg name="y" type="number">The Y part of the vertex' tangent T.</arg>
		<arg name="z" type="number">The Z part of the vertex' tangent T.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
